evals.name: secure-http-boundary
evals.prompt: Review a Go endpoint accepting a token and account ID, then calling a privileged repository operation.
evals.expected_output: A security review and minimal fixes covering trust boundaries, authorization, validation, and leakage.
assertions: Authentication and authorization are distinguished and enforced before the privileged operation.
Untrusted input is validated and parameterized at downstream boundaries.
Tokens and internal failure details are not logged or returned.

evals.name: prevent-injection-attacks
evals.prompt: Prevent SQL injection, command injection, and path traversal in an attachment download handler.
evals.expected_output: Input sanitization with filepath.Clean, filepath.Base, and parameterized DB queries.
assertions: Uses filepath.Base and filepath.Clean to prevent directory traversal (../).
Uses parameterized SQL queries without string concatenation.
Validates file extensions against a strict allowlist.

evals.name: tls-and-security-headers
evals.prompt: Configure an HTTP server with modern TLS defaults and security headers.
evals.expected_output: Server configuration specifying TLS 1.3 minimum and middleware adding HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, etc.
assertions: Configures tls.Config with MinVersion = tls.VersionTLS12 (or TLS 1.3).
Adds X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff and X-Frame-Options: DENY.
